description: Create one or more files atomically; per-file overwrite and parents flags. For a conflict-safe overwrite pass the revision from coder::read-file as expected_revision (stale revision: C221, nothing written). Paths: relative to the primary root or absolute inside an allowed root (see coder::info).

expected_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard for an overwrite: the `revision` from coder::read-file; if the content changed the entry fails C221 unwritten.

mode.description: Octal permission bits as a string, e.g. "0644". Defaults to "0644".

overwrite.description: When false (the default), refuse to write if `path` already exists.

parents.description: Create missing parent directories. Defaults to true so a single `coder::create-file` call can scaffold a fresh subtree.

error.description: Structured error for this entry. `code` is stable for programmatic branching (e.g. `"C213"` means already-exists; pass `overwrite=true` to replace). `message` carries the corrective action an LLM agent needs to make a successful second call.

path.description: Canonical absolute path (resolved through the jail); the caller's input verbatim when resolution failed.

revision.description: Opaque revision for the exact bytes written. Supply this as `expected_revision` on a later overwrite to avoid lost updates.

WireError.description:
Structured per-entry error as it appears on the wire.

Use `code` for stable programmatic branching (e.g. `"C211"` for not-found-or-denied). `message` carries the human/LLM-readable problem description plus the corrective next call.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. "C211". See the README error table.

message.description: Human/LLM-readable message: problem + actual values + corrective next call.
